$comment: Every dependency the agent is permitted to install. Checked by scripts/check-deps.mjs against package.json. An addition here is a deliberate human decision, not something the agent edits on its own — see AGENTS.md. Covers the npm side only — backend/pyproject.toml pins the Phase 8 Python backend's dependencies with no mechanical allowlist enforcer yet (see docs/DEFERRED.md).

shadcnInit.$comment: Exact flags used for `npx shadcn@<tools.shadcn> init` — reuse these, don't re-prompt, so every session's `add` commands land in a project configured the same way.
